conclusion.justification: The report concludes that hypnosis is 'probably not as a reliably effective stand-alone treatment' and notes that high-quality evidence does not establish it works better than standard behavioral support or quitting without assistance. Because it presents a cautiously unfavorable view of the claim's effectiveness while acknowledging possible small benefits for some individuals, it is classified as leans_reject.

report:
**Conclusion: probably not as a reliably effective stand-alone treatment.** Hypnosis may help some motivated individuals quit, but the best synthesis of randomized evidence does **not** establish that it works better than standard behavioral support or quitting without assistance.

The 2019 Cochrane review concluded that evidence was insufficient to determine whether hypnotherapy outperforms other behavioral support or unassisted quitting; if there is a benefit, it is likely small. This conclusion reflects small trials, variable hypnosis methods, and limitations in study quality and long-term verification of abstinence.  
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6568235/

There are signals in favor of hypnosis: individual randomized trials have tested it against relaxation or counseling, and a new 2025 systematic review identified 63 papers. But a large number of papers does not resolve the central problems of heterogeneous interventions and uneven trial quality; newer reviews therefore should not yet overturn the Cochrane conclusion.  
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24365274/  
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39773364/

For someone who wants to try hypnosis and finds it engaging, it can be a reasonable *adjunct*—provided it does not replace proven care. CDC recommends counseling plus cessation medication as the approach giving the best chance of permanent quitting. Evidence-based options include nicotine replacement (patch/gum/lozenge), varenicline or bupropion when medically appropriate, and behavioral/quitline support.  
https://www.cdc.gov/tobacco/about/how-to-quit.html
